verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a first-party Serverless platform that runs workloads without managing GPUs and bills for execution rather than rental time. It offers benchmark-driven automatic scaling and is driven by a Python SDK, CLI and serverless endpoint client. Scale-to-zero is only implied by execution-based billing, never stated, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit scale-to-zero documentation, autoscaling configuration details (min/max workers, cold starts), code deployment workflow docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: Vast Serverless is an AI infrastructure platform that lets you run compute-intensive workloads without managing GPUs, paying for execution rather than GPU rental time.
Benchmark-driven scaling: Automatic identification and recruitment of the best price-performance GPU to scale your unique workload.
Interacting with Vast Serverless is made easy through a powerful python SDK.
plus a serverless client for endpoint inference
